edges: Pablo's father plans for Pablo to marry his beautiful cousin, Florentina.
Pablo eventually gets the operation that gives him his sight.
Pablo finds his way to Marianela's room and serenades Florentina.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Marianela loves Pablo, and Pablo has feelings for Marianela.

edges: Pablo's father asks Teodoro Golfin to examine Pablo to see if his sight can be restored.
Pablo promises Marianela that he will marry her after the operation if it is successful.
Pablo sees Florentina first and proposes to her instead of Marianela.
Pablo confuses Marianela for just a poor girl taken in from the street.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Marianela loves Pablo, and Pablo has feelings for Marianela.
